we developed an automatic approach for identifying and classifying security objectives from natural language artifacts and we developed context-specific templates to help instantiate security requirements from security-relevant natural language sentences.

the automatic identification of security requirements from natural-language requirements artifacts.
automatically identifying and classifying security requirements in natural language artifacts.

we can use natural language processing to extract security-relevant information and classify security objectives from natural language artifacts.
our tool-assisted process helps requirements engineers to identify security-relevant sentences and classify them according to security objectives.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a machine learning-based process that can be used to automatically identify security-relevant sentences and classify security objectives in requirements artifacts.

we developed a tool-assist process that can help requirements engineers to identify security-relevant sentences and classify them into different security objectives and then use the information from the sentences to instantiate security requirements templates.

our process can be used to automatically identify security-relevant sentences and security objectives in natural language artifacts, and can be used as an initial step in the security requirements engineering process.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we can automatically extract security objectives and security requirements from natural languages artifacts, which can be used as a starting point for security engineers to produce a comprehensive security requirement specification.
